owner: CC owns the code, the proofs and the probe at inference_domain, and the one trailing SCAFFOLD string at aider_shim/translate.py. Akien owns the ruling that bore it
children: none. The reader primitive and the raw-body carry are two edits at ONE seam, proved by one proof under one gate-set, and neither is separately shippable: a reader over a record that still drops the body hands back an incomplete record CONFIDENTLY, which is the hollow-green shape falsifier (c) exists to catch. The trailing SCAFFOLD line is a third piece of the same voyage, named for the decompose berth rather than spawned as a node — it is one frozen string whose only reason to exist is that this ticket gives its answer somewhere to land.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(inference_ticket_comes_back_whole) -> [PROVED] (proved 2026-08-26: sealed under netns, emission gate clean, clearance by CC onto cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain.py)

watchme.trigger: read on demand against the standing `inference_calls` log — every recorded call is a row, so the probe has a population without arranging one. In practice it is read after an apprentice drive, which is the consumer that makes it interesting.
watchme.enough: DELIBERATELY ASYMMETRIC, the same shape the writes_to watch settled on. ONE row created after the build whose `answer` carries no body — a call that went through the new parse and still recorded only what we thought to extract — is STRONG falsification and satisfies it alone. Ten apprentice-drive tickets pulled back whole, request and body both, is WEAK confirmation and also satisfies it. Rows predating the build are UNKNOWABLE with a per-row why_unknowable sentence and count toward neither: the honest starting reading is expected to be zero countable, and that is a starting state, not a green.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, plus the probe's own per-row readings (countable | unknowable, with the why on each unknowable row).
watchme.nexus: cairn/devices/inference_domain — its how_it_learns surface, where yield_report already turns the same rows into the spent-vs-avoided measurement; this teaches the second question those rows can answer.
watchme.consumer: CC reading a drive after the fact, and the aider_shim's clause-(7) check — which today can only audit its own spans before aider wraps them, and gains a wire-level reading it has never had.

dependencies: none blocking. Both addresses exist and are proved; the `inference_calls` log is on disk and is its own fixture. The interceptor's `answer.get("text", "")` at interceptor.py:294 is the one downstream reader of the changed shape and is untouched by an additive key.
